repository.name: WinBookSplit
repository.description: A "drop-and-forget" PDF/AZW3/EPUB decomposition tool for technical manuals, textbooks, and heavy documentation. Large PDFs are often unwieldy for e-readers or quick reference, this script treats a PDF like a modular project—dropping a massive book in and getting a clean, organized folder of individual chapters out.
